nodes.speaker: captain_maer
lines: Bandit chief. Calls himself the Twisted Hand.
He's been hitting supply routes. Fifty gold for proof of death.

nodes.speaker: captain_maer
lines: She counts the coins without looking at the proof.
"Job done. We'll clean up the rest."

nodes.speaker: road_scout_npc
lines: My partner went ahead to scout the crossroads. That was two days ago.
I can't leave post. You could look.
The scout is alive. Barely.
Captured by the bandit cell. Still in the camp.

nodes.speaker: swamp_guide
lines: Healer's run short of fenwort. Grows in the deep fen — where the corpse-lanterns are.
Ten bunches for twenty gold. Or a healer's favor. Your choice.

nodes.speaker: swamp_guide
lines: She takes the herbs without counting.
"They're fresh. Good. We needed them yesterday."

nodes.speaker: captain_maer
lines: Three Ashen Veil agents. Inside the city walls.
We know faces. We don't know where they sleep.
"Thirty gold and Emberguard recognition. Enough to open some doors."

nodes.speaker: veil_shrinekeeper
lines: Three shrines in the Stoneward. Two corrupted, one merely dormant.
The Pact will compensate anyone who brings them back.
"Not coin. Old favors. The kind that come through when you need a shelter that doesn't ask questions."

nodes.speaker: veil_convert
lines: Veil defector. She needs to reach the Thornpact safehouse in the crossroads.
The Harvesters have a bounty on her — alive, unfortunately for her.

choices.text: [Diplomacy - INT] Name a price for the escort.

nodes.speaker: elderwood_hermit
lines: Old gate. Sealed by a riddle instead of a lock.
The hermit has been sitting in front of it for twelve years.

choices.text: Ask the hermit what he's tried.

lines: The lock dissolves. The hermit stares. "Twelve years," he says quietly.
The gate doesn't open. It falls. The hermit winces at the noise.
The gate stays. The hermit nods. "Yes. I know."
"I've tried eighty-three solutions. The gate appears to be judging something about the person asking, not the answer."

nodes.speaker: brightfall_innkeeper
lines: Bandit camp two miles north has been eating the supply caravans.
Forty gold if you clear it. Sixty if you leave the camp usable for travelers.

choices.text: Clear it and leave it standing. (60 gold)

nodes.speaker: merchant_unusual
lines: He lost a crate in the fen. Medical supplies — expensive, legal ones.
Recovery fee: twenty percent of the declared value, which is probably accurate.
"Three hundred gold. Your cut is sixty. If you can haul it out of a fen infested with plague creatures."

nodes.speaker: faction_envoy_thornpact
lines: Deliver a sealed packet to the Thornpact contact at the eastern inn.
Don't open it. Don't let anyone else open it.
Maps of Ashen Veil cell locations. Seven of them. And a name — the Veil's inside man in the Brightfall Council.
The seal breaks wrong. There's no repairing it without being obvious.

nodes.speaker: captain_maer
lines: The Herald. Ashen Veil's organizer in Act 1.
He's been spotted in the Gloomridge caves. Fifty gold, alive or dead. Sixty if the cult records come with him.

choices.text: Bring him and the records. (60 gold)

nodes.speaker: brightfall_innkeeper
lines: The Council needs a Veil dossier retrieved from a dead drop.
"The Iron Covenant is watching the drop. We can't retrieve it ourselves without questions."

choices.text: [Diplomacy - INT] Demand double the offered fee.

nodes.speaker: merchant_unusual
lines: Plague Harvester sample contract. Collect specimen types, specified in the paperwork.
The paperwork is deliberately confusing. The pay is not.

choices.text: [Perception - INT] Read the actual fine print.

lines: The specimens include living human tissue. From living subjects. The paperwork is very clear about this.

nodes.speaker: veil_convert
lines: She has information. The Veil wants her dead before she shares it.
"Get me to the Thornpact house and you can have everything I know."

choices.text: [Diplomacy - INT] Ask for a preview of the information.

lines: "The Herald isn't dead. He's working with someone inside the Brightfall Council." That's the preview. The rest she keeps until she's safe.

nodes.speaker: bone_reader
lines: There's a scroll under the third pillar of the old hall. Pre-Sovereign.
I'd go myself but my legs gave out at sixty and the hall has two floors of stairs.
"A reading. I can tell things from bones — yours, your companions'. Things you haven't noticed about yourselves."

nodes.speaker: road_scout_npc
lines: Oathless ex-soldier. The Emberguard has something of his — taken when he broke covenant.
"A letter. Just a letter. From my daughter. I need it back."

nodes.speaker: road_scout_npc
lines: Something's not right. Heard whispers in the trees.
We lost two of ours last night. We need help.

nodes.speaker: bone_reader
lines: The bones tell stories of the lost. They hear your questions.
But I cannot speak to the ash; it requires a cost.

choices.text: Offer fifty gold for the reading.

nodes.speaker: veil_shrinekeeper
lines: The Riftgate holds fragmented whispers of the past.
Retrieve a shard, and hear the truth of what lies ahead.

nodes.speaker: road_scout_npc
lines: Something's been lurking in the shadows. My partner hasn't returned for hours.
I fear the worst. Will you help search?

choices.text: Agree to search for the partner.

nodes.speaker: tessaly_veil
lines: The Veil's presence feels stronger near the old ruins.
I need someone to scout the area. Will you?

choices.text: "I have my own path to follow."

nodes.speaker: elderwood_hermit
lines: This place is hollow now. It cries for aid.

choices.text: Agree to help restore the shrine.

nodes.speaker: bone_reader
lines: The land remembers, even if we do not.
Find the remnants of the old shrine. It may still speak.

nodes.speaker: veil_shrinekeeper
lines: The rift is unstable. It whispers to me in a way I can't ignore.
You seek something from it? You must tread carefully.

choices.text: I understand. I'll proceed with caution.

nodes.speaker: ash_prophet_npc
lines: The Sovereign's approach is imminent. Prepare yourselves accordingly.
A choice lies ahead. One cannot turn back from it.

choices.text: We're ready for what comes next.

nodes.speaker: bram_coldfire
lines: The rift holds more than we understand. I've seen it.
If we breach it, we might lose ourselves forever.

choices.text: We need answers. We must breach it.
"It's too risky. We should hold back."

nodes.speaker: lyra_ashwalker
lines: There are remnants here. They hold secrets.
If you search well, perhaps you'll find a key.

nodes.speaker: null
lines: A distant rumble shakes the air. The rift stirs with energy.
Decisions must be made, and soon.

choices.text: [Wisdom - WIS] Take a moment to evaluate the situation.

nodes.speaker: road_scout_npc
lines: I've heard whispers of the Ashen Veil nearby.
If you're going that way, take care. They don't take kindly to outsiders.

choices.text: Sounds like a tale to scare children.

nodes.speaker: brightfall_innkeeper
lines: Strange folk have been asking about you.
Best keep your head down and your coin close.

nodes.speaker: null
lines: A discarded dagger, blood caked on its hilt.
This road isn't safe. Better turn back.

nodes.speaker: yasha_stonewill
lines: The Gloomridge is cursed. You'll do best to avoid it.
But if you must go, take this warning.

nodes.speaker: null
lines: Footprints in the mud, too many for comfort.
Someone's been watching. Keep your guard up.

nodes.speaker: bone_reader
lines: The air is thick with ash. Lost souls wander here.
Find the bones of the fallen. They deserve rest.

nodes.speaker: lyra_ashwalker
lines: The ash hides more than it shows. There are whispers here.
Find the source of the tremors. Something stirs beneath.

choices.text: Search for the source of the tremors.

nodes.speaker: bram_coldfire
lines: The ash burns differently. It feels alive.
I need someone to gather samples from the deeper fields.

nodes.speaker: yasha_stonewill
lines: The spirits grow restless. Something is awakening here.
We must perform a rite to quell their fury.

nodes.speaker: tessaly_veil
lines: The Veil's influence spreads. I can feel it.
Find the corrupted artifact. We need to know its power.

choices.text: [Diplomacy - CHA] Convince her it's too risky.

nodes.speaker: road_scout_npc
lines: I've seen shadows moving near the old mill.
Something stirs in the night. Might be worth investigating.

nodes.speaker: bone_reader
lines: The ashes whisper of a lost child. Missing for a week now.
Search near the old ruins. Start where the shadows linger.

choices.text: Agree to search for the child.

nodes.speaker: veil_shrinekeeper
lines: The Veil's hunger is growing. We must disrupt their rituals.

choices.text: Agree to assist in disrupting the rituals.

nodes.speaker: bram_coldfire
lines: There's a hidden cache near the gate. Worth the trouble if you can find it.

nodes.speaker: yasha_stonewill
lines: A cultist has been spotted near the gate. Deal with him before he warns others.

nodes.speaker: road_scout_npc
lines: Recently, shadows have been moving near the old quarry.
I swear I saw something lurking among the stones.

nodes.speaker: yasha_stonewill
lines: We're running low on supplies. The Veil is getting close.
Need someone to scavenge what they can from the ruins.

nodes.speaker: veil_shrinekeeper
lines: The shrine's taint is deepening. We need to cleanse it.
Will you assist with the ritual? It requires focus.

choices.text: Agree to help with the ritual.
Rituals are no concern of mine.

nodes.speaker: bone_reader
lines: The ash whispers of lost souls.
Their stories haunt this ground, seeking release.

choices.text: Offer to help the restless spirits.
Leave the bone reader to their work.

nodes.speaker: oren_gravetide
lines: A creature haunts the remains of the old village.
It takes more than it gives, a shadow of hunger.

choices.text: Agree to hunt the creature down.

nodes.speaker: veil_shrinekeeper
lines: The shrine's heartstone is crumbling.
Its light barely holds the Veil at bay.

choices.text: Offer to help restore the heartstone.
Turn your back on the shrine.

nodes.speaker: lyra_ashwalker
lines: The land weeps under the weight of the Veil.
I've lost too many friends to its whispers.

choices.text: Offer to assist her in gathering herbs.
Tell her to handle it herself.

nodes.speaker: yasha_stonewill
lines: There's a storm brewing in the ash.
We need a shield, or we won't see dawn.

choices.text: [Mechanisms - INT] Offer your skills to fortify defenses.
Say you have your own path.

nodes.speaker: veil_shrinekeeper
lines: The heartstone lies shattered. We've lost much of our power.
You must find the shards before the Veil consumes this place.

choices.text: Agree to search for the shards.
